narrative.overview:
Milli Pərdə is a catalogue of Azerbaijani national cinema built as a near-black cinema room: a charcoal field (#131316) with a deeper well (#0e0e11) for chrome and a single saturated cinema red (#e50914) that marks the one thing to do next, which is to play a film. The film frames themselves, real YouTube stills in 16:9, supply all the color and imagery; the interface stays out of their way.

Density is medium and carousel-driven: horizontal rows of frames, generous 40px vertical rhythm between rows, and rounded soft surfaces rather than hard edges. Depth comes from tonal layering of near-black surfaces; shadows are soft and black. All interface copy is Azerbaijani; the Ə/ə glyphs are part of the brand, which is why the title face is Oswald.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal near-black layering from #0e0e11 to #353438, no light surfaces.
One red, used for the primary action, active state, hover fill and the Pərdə half of the wordmark.
Condensed uppercase Oswald titles over Plus Jakarta Sans text.
16:9 film stills with a red circular play affordance on hover and focus.
Circular grey monogram initials where no verified person photo exists.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks the next action or the current location, nothing else. If two red elements compete in the same viewport, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tonal Ladder Rule
rules.body: Layers separate by stepping one rung up the surface ladder, not by borders. Cards may carry a 1px white-at-5% ring as the only edge.

rules.name: The Oswald-for-Titles Rule
rules.body: Oswald is uppercase and used only for titles, row headings and the wordmark. Reading text, buttons, labels and metadata are always Plus Jakarta Sans.

rules.name: The Black Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black, long-offset and diffuse. No hard offset shadows, no colored glows.

dos: Do use Cinema Red (#e50914) only for the primary action, active state and hover fill.
Do keep the page on the tonal ladder (#0e0e11 to #353438) and separate layers by one rung.
Do set titles in uppercase Oswald and everything readable in Plus Jakarta Sans; keep Ə/ə visible in titles.
Do show film frames at 16:9 with the 12px card radius and the red play disc on hover and focus.
Do tag trailers, fragments and searches in Amber Note so the link is honest.
Do use real person photos from Wikipedia or Wikimedia Commons when verified, otherwise the monogram.
Do keep the Rose Accent focus ring on every interactive element and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't add ratings, scores, watchlists or view counts; the product has none.
Don't use light surfaces, gradients on buttons, or a second saturated hue.
Don't use hard offset or colored shadows.
Don't set body or UI labels in Oswald, or titles in lowercase.
Don't invent posters; cards show real video frames or the title-card fallback.
